bounds_rule: Coordinatewise min/max from 39 optimization-source initial positions; internal validation ID49 is excluded from range estimation. Product-uniform sampling inside this empirical box is a new supplemental distribution, not a claimed reconstruction of LIBERO original sampler.
unchanged_fields: All robot/cabinet states, bowl/plate z and quaternions are copied from the lowest optimization reference ID. No clipping of inherited negative second-finger initial value.
duplicate_test_rule: Exact full-state and object-configuration hashes must be unique; no additional minimum test-to-test spacing.
passive_action: Hold the canonical initial joint-position targets; no pickup, no reference action replay, no policy. Fresh mj_resetData before each candidate.
known_inherited_robot_issue: Reference second finger starts negative and relaxes to its joint stop. Physical admissibility here concerns bowl/plate support and undesired object contacts, not a claim that every original robot joint is initially within limits. The inherited robot state is identical for both methods.
selection: First 50 passing candidates in deterministic stream; all rejected candidate states and reasons retained. No checkpoint execution or success-based filtering.
execution: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty; MUJOCO_GL=disable; CPU physics and no renderer; no policy or checkpoint loaded.
